title: Use CMS/WordPress/Elementor as primary preset
summary: The execution environment, safety boundaries, and compatibility risks are WordPress/Elementor concerns.
rationale: The visual frames are important, but the plugin must preserve WordPress admin behavior, saved options, nonces, capabilities, escaping, and Elementor Free compatibility.
alternatives_considered: Visual Front-End First as primary preset
risks: The plan must still enforce visual QA or it can drift into a generic settings screen.
